owed_tests: migrate_semantics::SealKeepsTheSameRule.test_an_approval_of_a_selected_contract_is_not_kept_and_is_named (one test closes all four g3 mutants). Input: the existing era_bundle() fixture — seal(authoring(), approvals=old['approvals'], exposed=exposure_of(old)) yields 6 withheld rows. Reader: bundle_cli.main (bundle_cli.py:1045) prints report['approvals_withheld_semantic'] as JSON for the operator; each row names a withheld ContractApproval. Sketch: for each r in report['approvals_withheld_semantic'], assertEqual(set(r), {'contract','requirement','approver','approved_at','changes'}); and for the BC-GREP-DIR-REQ row assert r['requirement']=='R-1' and r['approved_at']==100.0 (mirrors the already-present sibling guard on the migrate row at migrate_semantics:377-378). This kills index 128 (no 'requirement'), 150 ('' key), 130 (no 'approved_at'), 152 ('' key). Optional strengthening: a withheld contract citing two requirement_ids, to show 'requirement' is the disambiguator between two otherwise-identical rows. No test is owed for the EQUIVALENT mutants (7,121,155,160): adding one would only re-assert list==tuple after the kernel's own normalization.
